name: OPQA
intro: OPQA（OpenAI-Proof Q&A）是 OpenAI 系统卡中使用的内部研究与工程诊断评测，包含会导致大型项目延迟的问题，要求模型在容器、代码和运行产物中定位并解释复杂问题。
task_type: Agent任务, 代码调试, 研究工程诊断
eval_feature: 内部评测, 代码执行环境
task_type_en: Agent task, code debugging, research engineering diagnosis
intro_en: OPQA, OpenAI-Proof Q&A, is an internal research and engineering diagnosis evaluation used by OpenAI system cards, with project-blocking tasks that require models to inspect containers, code, and run artifacts to diagnose complex issues.
